data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
(Supporting task for completion-verifier evidence — enables mechanical SC-1 verification)

## Implementation Notes
Create plugins/dso/docs/visual-evaluator-sc1-coverage.md as a 3-column traceability table:
| SC-1 Sub-criterion | Schema Field | Agent Anchor | Test |
Each row maps a specific SC-1 requirement to its implementation artifact.

Rows to cover:
- bbox_confidence field (anchored|inferred) → visual-evaluator-schema.json → agent bbox rules → test_visual_evaluator_agent.py
- dom_xpath_visually_consistent boolean → schema → agent DOM-cross-check logic → test_visual_evaluator_domcheck.py
- attribution_class enum → schema → attribution decision tree → structural test
- attribution_confidence enum → schema → confidence derivation rules → schema test
- scores.{5 dimensions} integer 1-5 → schema scores object → 25 rubric anchors → schema test
- findings array structure → schema → agent emission rules → schema test

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Coverage table file exists
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/visual-evaluator-sc1-coverage.md
- [ ] Table contains all 6 SC-1 sub-criteria rows
  Verify: python3 -c "c=open('plugins/dso/docs/visual-evaluator-sc1-coverage.md').read(); assert c.count('|') > 24"
- [ ] All 6 schema field names appear in the table
  Verify: python3 -c "c=open('plugins/dso/docs/visual-evaluator-sc1-coverage.md').read(); assert all(f in c for f in ['bbox_confidence','dom_xpath_visually_consistent','attribution_class','attribution_confidence','scores','findings'])"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user
data.title: Create SC-1 traceability table mapping schema fields to agent anchors and regression tests
